oneOf.description: With `files`, the files with the most results first.

Sources.description: Which sources a build system declares.

after.description: Return the results after this place, as a page's `next` gives it.

count.description: Return how many results there are, not the results.

depth.description: Levels followed, 1 for the direct ones only.

files.description: Return one row per file, with its number of results, paged by file.

here.description: Limit results to the current directory's subtree.

kind.description: Consider types of this kind only; repeatable.

path.description: Limit results to this subtree; repeatable.

sort.description: With files, `count` puts the files with the most results first, on one page.

sources.description: Keep main or test sources only, as the build systems declare them.

super.description: List its supertypes, up to the roots, instead of what extends or implements it.

symbol.description: Type ID, its path part, `file:line:col`, or a name.
